acquisition method: MS survey scan across 450–2000 m/z was acquired in data-dependent mode and positive ion mode with a spray voltage of 2.1 kV.
cleavage agent: 1 μg trypsin/lysC (Promega, part no. V5073) was added to each sample and the reaction was incubated overnight at 37 °C.
collision energy: normalized collision energy = 30%... the top 10 most abundant ions in each MS scan were selected for the MS/MS scan with a normalized collision energy of 35%.
enrichment method: the lysate was immunoprecipitated with pre-washed FLAG M2® affinity gel (Sigma-Aldrich) through the overnight incubation at 4 °C.
fragmentation method: The selected precursor was fragmented by HCD and analyzed by orbitrap.
instrument: Orbitrap Exploris 240, Finnigan LTQ linear ion trap mass spectrometer
